mission_06: Well done! You have mastered pipeline serialization, a critical skill for deploying machine learning models to production. By saving the entire pipeline (preprocessing + model) as a single serialized object, you ensure that inference uses exactly the same transformations as training, eliminating the most common source of production ML bugs. Joblib is the recommended format for sklearn pipelines due to its efficient handling of numpy arrays, often producing smaller files than pickle. The verification step confirms that loaded models produce identical predictions, which is essential for deployment confidence. This serialization pattern is the foundation of ML model deployment, whether you are serving predictions via a REST API, running batch inference jobs, or embedding models in edge devices.
